decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the flat is occupied.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The proposed new windows in the flank elevation shall be hinged to open inwards
description: Change of use from retail/residential to  ground floor self-contained  flat and erection of single storey rear extension. (AMENDED DESCRIPTON)
